name: MandAPI
description: MandAPI is an OpenAI-compatible, multi-model AI developer API. A single API key can access available GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and other models. Model availability and supported parameters depend on the model and account; retrieve the current list with GET /v1/models before sending a request.
